title: battle_pack.bin container (and nested section 61 pack)

container.notes: Little-endian. u32 sectionCount at 0x00, then sectionCount+1 u32 file-relative offsets starting at 0x04 (the extra last one is the end-of-data offset, recorded before final padding). Every section start is 16-byte aligned with zero fill. Section i spans [offset[i], offset[i+1]); empty sections have the same offset as the next section (never 0). battle_pack.bin has 71 sections (0-70). Section 61 is the same container with 15 sections (0-14), all FFXII text tables. Rebuilt header sizes: 292 bytes -> first section 0x130 (N=71); 68 bytes -> first sub-section 0x50 (N=15). The game turns the offsets into absolute pointers after load; on disk they are offsets.

fields.name: sectionCount
fields.notes: Number of sections (71 for battle_pack.bin). The offset table that follows has sectionCount + 1 entries. Do not change.

records.name: sectionOffset
records.where: battle_pack.bin file offset 4, directly after packHeader; entry i is at 4 + 4*i

fields.name: offset
fields.notes: File-relative start of section i (row number = section index; row names in enum BattlepackSection). Row sectionCount is the end-of-data offset (end of the last section's bytes, before the file's final 16-byte padding). Values are non-decreasing and every section start is a multiple of 16. Recompute all rows after the edited section when a section changes size.

records.name: section61Header
records.where: start of battlepack section 61 (offset = sectionOffset[61]); offsets inside are relative to the start of section 61

fields.name: offset
fields.notes: Offset of sub-section i relative to the start of section 61; 16-byte aligned. Last row is the end-of-data offset. Same rules as the outer pack.

BattlepackSectionLayout.0: custom: u16 entrySize, u16 count, entries from +4
BattlepackSectionLayout.10: offset table: u32 count, count+1 u32 offsets, 4-byte entries
BattlepackSectionLayout.13: st2e:52 + attribute list (24-byte records) at header+0x18
BattlepackSectionLayout.39: bespoke: shops -> events -> contents with 6-byte tagged headers
BattlepackSectionLayout.70: licd: magic, u16 columns, u16 rows, u16 cells

roundTrip: Keep sectionCount (71; 15 inside section 61) and the section order unchanged.
Unedited sections must be copied byte-for-byte, including the zero padding that follows them up to the next 16-byte boundary.
Lay out sections in index order: pad with zeros to a multiple of 16, record the start offset, append the section bytes.
An empty section keeps length 0 and gets the same offset as the following section; never write offset 0 for it.
The last table row (index sectionCount) is the end of the last section's real data, written before the file is zero-padded to a multiple of 16.

Offsets inside a section are relative to that section, so moving a section needs no internal fix-up; only resizing within sections 0, 10, 13, 39, 61 or 70 requires their own internal offsets to be recomputed.
Rebuild section 61 (inner pack) before rebuilding battle_pack.bin.
gaps: Not verified against a clean vanilla dump: first section offset (0x130 expected for a tightly packed rebuild) and first sub-section offset of section 61 (0x50 expected).
Not verified whether vanilla pads the file length to 16 after the end-of-data offset.
Sections 1, 4, 19-25, 36, 40, 43-56 and 62-67 have no known reader; treat as opaque bytes.
